'''Huper Tenrecs''' was a [[Talpiddian]] weapons specialist who served the [[Resistance]] as an armorer for the [[Resistance base (Ajan Kloss)|base]] on the [[jungle]] [[moon]] [[Ajan Kloss]]. He was unrivaled in his repair skills, but had difficulty distinguishing the faces of his fellow personnel, instead recognizing them by their equipment. In [[35 ABY]], he attended a meeting at the base where it was revealed that the [[Sith Lord]] [[Darth Sidious]] had returned with the [[Final Order]], a massive fleet of [[Xyston-class Star Destroyer|''Xyston''-class Star Destroyers]] built by the [[Sith Eternal]], at his disposal.

==Biography==
Huper Tenrecs was a [[Talpiddian]] who worked as a weapons specialist for the [[Resistance]] during their [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] against the [[First Order]]. He was part of the Resistance group that set up [[Resistance base (Ajan Kloss)|base]] on the [[jungle]] [[moon]] [[Ajan Kloss]] and acted as the base's [[armor]]er.<ref name="TROS VD" />

In [[35 ABY]],<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> he was amongst the base personnel who attended a meeting following the return of the [[YT-1300 light freighter]] known as the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' from a [[Mission to Sinta Glacier Colony|intelligence gathering mission]]. [[Commander]] [[Poe Dameron]] informed those gathered that they had received data confirming that the [[Sith Lord]] [[Darth Sidious]] had returned and that the [[Sith Eternal]]'s [[fleet]], the [[Final Order]], from the [[planet]] [[Exegol]] was going to reinforce the First Order.<ref name="TROS">{{Film|IX}}</ref>

He later stood beside the [[technician]] [[Klaud]] during a second meeting at the base in which Dameron laid out a plan to [[Battle of Exegol|attack]] the [[Sith Eternal military|Sith Eternal forces]] on the [[planet]] [[Exegol]]. Following the successful attack, Tenrecs joined in with the victory celebrations held at the base, hugging a [[human]] beside one of the [[RZ-2 A-wing interceptor]]s that had returned from Exegol.<ref name="TROS" />

==Personality and traits==
Tenrecs had unrivaled repair skills due to his visual acuity at close range, but was almost completely unable to identify other Resistance members, particularly [[human]]s, by their appearance, instead identifying them by the gear they carried. The Talpiddian had light skin, [[Color|gray]] [[hair]] and black [[eye]]s.<ref name="TROS VD" />

==Equipment==
Tenrecs wore a brown [[Clothing|tunic]] with multi-colored stripes and brown pants. He had a brown [[belt]] and [[bandolier]] and carried a [[EL-16HFE blaster rifle]] with an acoustic aiming aid.<ref name="TROS VD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Huper Tenrecs first appeared in the [[2019]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']],<ref name="TROS" /> played by creature performer [[Hugh Purves]];<ref name="Tweet">{{Twitter|Hugh_Purves|1212362840310464513|[[Hugh Purves]]|quote=On this, the first day of the decade, please enjoy this representation of the culmination of all my dreams for the last 2 decades:Https: // Starwars.Fandom.Com/wiki/Huper_Ten Recs ... My Name In Fuckin 'Star Wars!|nobackup=yes|archivedate=20200104154706}}</ref> and was first identified in the accompanying reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="TROS VD" />
